name: Java Spring Boot
test_cmd: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw -B test; elif [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn -B test; elif [ -f ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew test; else gradle test; fi
lint_cmd: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw -B spotless:check; elif [ -f pom.xml ]; then mvn -B spotless:check; elif [ -f ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew check -x test; else gradle check -x test; fi
